item.title: ❗️ During the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out strikes against Ukrainian ports and vessels used in the interests of the AFU.
item.description: ❗️ During the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out strikes against Ukrainian ports and vessels used in the interests of the AFU. As a result of UAV strikes, the following targets were hit: ▪️ in the port of Chernomorsk, a Ro‑Ro ship that delivered cargo to support the Armed Forces of Ukraine; ▪️ in the port of Izmail, a tanker that delivered fuel and lubricants for the AFU. ▪️ in the Yuzhny port, a rolling stock used to support the AFU at the moment of cargo loading. ▪️ In addition, strikes against railway infrastructure facilities in the western regions of Ukraine which are used to transport military cargo from European countries have been continued. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ✈️ Tu-95ms in air Tu-95ms long-range bombers of the Russian Aerospace Forces conducted a planned flight
item.description: Tu-95ms in air ✈️ Tu-95ms long-range bombers of the Russian Aerospace Forces conducted a planned flight over the neutral waters of the Barents and Norwegian seas. ⏱️ The flight took about 5 hours. ▫️ Su-33 fighter jet crews of the Russian Navy escorted the bombers. At certain stages of the route, the long-range bombers were escorted by fighter jets from foreign countries. Crews of long-range aviation regularly conduct flights over the neutral waters of the Arctic, North Atlantic, Pacific Ocean, Black and Baltic seas. All flights of Russian Aerospace Forces aircraft are carried out in strict compliance with international rules on the use of airspace. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 15 September 2026
Part 2 (
👉
see
Part 1
)
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Russian troops inflicted fire damage on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, a motorised infantry brigade, an airmobile brigade, a mountain assault brigade of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade close to Druzhkovka, Orekhovatka, Kondratovka, Vasilevskaya Pustosh, Slavyansk, Starodubovka, Kramatorsk, and Nikolayevka in the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The enemy lost up to 165 troops, one Canadian-made Senator armoured fighting vehicle, 17 motor vehicles, and one British-made 155-mm Braveheart self-propelled artillery system.
📍
The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, an assault regiment of the AFU, a marine brigade, and two national guard brigades near Novovodyanoye, Dobropolye, Gulevo, Maryevka, Andreyevka, Belozerskoye (Donetsk People's Republic), and Ivanovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 345 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, 12 motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station.
↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence.
Russian troops inflicted damage on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, an air assault brigade, an assault regiment of the AFU, and a marine brigade near Ivanovka, Orestopol (Dnepropetrovsk region), Samoylovka, Omelnik, Vasilevskoye, and Obshcheye (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 285 troops, 13 motor vehicles, and a counter-fire station.
💥
Units of the Dnepr Group of Forces inflicted losses on
manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade of the AFU and two territorial defence brigades near Orekhov, Malokaterinovka, Yulyevka, Yurkovka, and Grigorovka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 35 troops, 15 motor vehicles, and three electronic warfare stations of the enemy were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Russian Groups of Forces inflicted damage on
Ukrainian energy and transport infrastructure used by the AFU, storage and assembly facilities of unmanned aerial vehicles, temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 139 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
six guided aerial bombs and 589 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.

item.title: ⚡️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. ⚡️ Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region continue to tighten the encirclement of the enemy's formations and expand the external control zone. 🚩 Control over Olkhovatka in Kharkov region has been established in the encirclement, and AFU formations blocked east of the settlement are being neutralised. 💥 Combat operations to liberate Malaya Volchya in Kharkov region are carried out. The coordinated fire damage was inflicted on manpower close to Khripuny and Buzovo of Kharkov region. ▪️ Within the past 24 hours, the enemy lost up to 35 troops in the encirclement. All attempts of the militants to break through the encirclement have been thwarted. 📊 Since the beginning of the month, up to 490 militants, 13 armoured fighting vehicles, eight pickup trucks, 13 ATVs, and 21 ground robotic systems have been neutralised. 💥 As a result of resolute actions to expand the external control zone, the enemy was hit close to Prikolotnoye, Novoaleksandrovka, and Petropavlovka of Kharkov region. ▪️ In Kharkov region, two assault groups of the AFU attempting to counter-attack near Kazachya Lopan (Kharkov region) were neutralised. 🔥 In addition, Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of a tank brigade, a mechanised brigade, a motorised infantry brigade, an assault regiment of the AFU, and two territorial defence brigades close to Zolochev, Martynovka, Chernoglazovka, Metallovka, and R
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29419

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
⚡️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region continue to tighten the encirclement of the enemy's formations
and expand the external control zone.
🚩
Control over Olkhovatka in Kharkov region has been established in the encirclement,
and AFU formations blocked east of the settlement are being neutralised.
💥
Combat operations to liberate Malaya Volchya in Kharkov region are carried out.
The coordinated fire damage was inflicted on manpower close to Khripuny and Buzovo of Kharkov region.
▪️
Within the past 24 hours, the enemy lost up to 35 troops in the encirclement. All attempts of the militants to break through the encirclement have been thwarted.
📊
Since the beginning of the month, up to 490 militants, 13 armoured fighting vehicles, eight pickup trucks, 13 ATVs, and 21 ground robotic systems have been neutralised.
💥
As a result of resolute actions to expand the external control zone, the enemy was hit
close to Prikolotnoye, Novoaleksandrovka, and Petropavlovka of Kharkov region.
▪️
In Kharkov region, two assault groups of the AFU attempting to counter-attack near Kazachya Lopan (Kharkov region) were neutralised.
🔥
In addition, Russian troops inflicted losses on
manpower and hardware of a tank brigade, a mechanised brigade, a motorised infantry brigade, an assault regiment of the AFU, and two territorial defence brigades close to Zolochev, Martynovka, Chernoglazovka, Metallovka, and Revoliutsionnoye of Kharkov region.
💥
In Sumy region,
units of a tank brigade, a mechanised brigade of the AFU, and two territorial defence brigades were hit near Boyaro-Lezhachi, Gnilitsa, and Khoten (Sumy region).
▪️
In total, up to 195 troops, three tanks, 11 motor vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations of the enemy have been neutralised in the Sever Group's area of responsibility.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
The Group's units inflicted losses on formations of two mechanised brigades, an assault brigade of the AFU, two marine brigades, and a territorial defence brigade close to Stetskovka, Chervony Oskol, Putnikovo, Petrovka, Studenok (Kharkov region), Bogorodichnoye, Prishib, and Sidorovo (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to up to 200 troops, 14 motor vehicles, two field artillery guns, and one electronic warfare station.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🎯 Clipping Polish Krab's claws In the course of air reconnaissance in Kramatorsk region,
item.description: Clipping Polish Krab's claws 🎯 In the course of air reconnaissance in Kramatorsk region, drone operators detected a Polish-made Krab self-propelled artillery system position. The enemy self-propelled artillery system was engaging advancing Russian units. 💥 A Msta-B howitzer crew struck the enemy's artillery unit. The system was disabled by the first hit, after which attack drones burned down the Krab. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation launched group strikes with unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics centres and ports of Ukraine, as well as vessels us
item.description: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation launched group strikes with unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics centres and ports of Ukraine, as well as vessels used in the interests of the AFU. The following targets were engaged: 📍 in Odessa region: a logistics centre in Velikaya Balka, which stored and distributed military cargo supplied to Ukraine from abroad; 📍 in the port of Chernomorsk, a dry cargo ship and a Ro-Ro ship delivering cargo to the AFU. 🔥 In addition, strikes against railway infrastructure facilities used to transport military cargo from European countries have been continued in western regions of Ukraine. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
